hints: Focus on counting atoms carefully from the skeletal structures, remembering each line end and bend is a carbon with enough hydrogens to make four bonds.
Check structures 1 and 2 first, both contain a C=O group with four carbons in total, so count their hydrogens to confirm C4H8O.
For structure 3, balance the loss of two hydrogens from the C=C double bond against the gain from the OH group to see if it still fits C4H8O.
walkthrough:
**Recall how to read skeletal formulae**

Count every carbon at line ends and junctions. Then add hydrogens so each carbon has four bonds.

Rule: $\text{molecular formula} = \text{total C + total H + total O}$

**Check substance 1, butan-2-one**

The skeleton shows $\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_3$. That is 4 carbons and 1 oxygen.

Hydrogens: $3 + 0 + 2 + 3 = 8$, so formula is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}$. Substance 1 is correct.

**Check substance 2, 2-methylpropanal**

The skeleton shows $\text{(CH}_3\text{)}_2\text{CHCHO}$. That is also 4 carbons and 1 oxygen.

Hydrogens: $3 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 8$, so formula is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}$. Substance 2 is correct.

**Check substance 3, but-3-en-1-ol**

The skeleton shows $\text{CH}_2\text{=CHCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$. That is 4 carbons and 1 oxygen.

Hydrogens: $2 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 \text{ (on O)} = 8$, so formula is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}$. The C=C removes 2 H but the saturated alcohol would be C4H10O, so this fits perfectly. Substance 3 is correct.

**Conclude the combination**

Since 1, 2 and 3 all have molecular formula $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}$, the correct combination is 1, 2 and 3.

options.A: Correct. All three structures contain 4 carbons, 8 hydrogens and 1 oxygen. 1 is butan-2-one, 2 is 2-methylpropanal, and 3 is but-3-en-1-ol, all isomers with formula C4H8O.
options.B: Incorrect. This option includes only 1 and 2. Students choose this if they correctly identify the carbonyl compounds but wrongly think the unsaturated alcohol must have a different formula.
options.C: Incorrect. This option includes only 2 and 3. Students choose this if they miscount structure 1 or confuse butan-2-one with another formula.
options.D: Incorrect. This option includes only 1. Students choose this if they think only ketones can be C4H8O and forget that aldehydes and unsaturated alcohols can be isomers with the same molecular formula.
